description: §7.6 rule (b) (S482) — the display `${g()}` runs before the `${ const k … }` written after it, and `g` reads `k`: E-SCOPE-001 (the S479 initializer rule extended to body code).
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S482): "A display — an interpolation, an attribute value that is not an event handler, a component's use-site value — or a body-top statement, at any depth of the `<program>` body, that reaches a file-scope binding whose place in the run comes after it — directly, or through a function it calls, at any depth — SHALL be `E-SCOPE-001`". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S481-run-order-followups item 2 — "E-SCOPE-001, the S479 file-scope-initializer rule extended to body code" (owner: "yes, adopt your recs on all three").
